name: What is a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-construction condo is a condominium unit purchased before or during its construction. Buyers typically reserve a unit with a deposit and make additional payments as construction progresses. This allows purchasers to secure a unit at an earlier price point and often customize certain finishes, though the customization options vary by developer and stage of construction. Kelby Contreras assists clients in understanding these early-stage purchasing agreements across Miami-Dade and Broward Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-construction condo is a unit purchased before or during its construction, typically allowing for customization and early pricing.
